body:
While attending a Burner event on the East Coast I was offered some 'acid'.
Had been in the area for a year and did not know the seller well.  Had not heard of 2C-I or its possible substitution for LSD in some markets. After taking it, the boyfriend (much more experienced than I with LSD) said he didn't think it was LSD and that it might be 2C-I.
While tripping I noticed that I had a feeling of a lump in my throat, as if my shirt was pressing against the front of my throat, although it wasn't.
Had never been diagnosed with hypothyroidism. About a year later, during a blood test, it turns out that my thyroid stimulating hormone is up, and I was diagnosed with 'subclinical' hypothyroidism, although I did not have antibodies to thyroid present, as is usually the case. I also noticed that I would occasionally get this same feeling of a lump in my throat, which is a mild kind of goiter, an enlargement of the thyroid gland that happens when the thyroid is being overstimulated (to try to produce more thyroid hormone).
Subsequently, I made the connection that the first time I had felt that 'lump in throat' feeling was while I was tripping on the 'acid' (probably 2C-I).
